name: moe_k_split_dual_stream
description: Split the K loop into two halves (K=0..3 and K=4..7) with independent load/MFMA cadences to hide weight HBM latency
preconditions: FP8 MoE GEMM with inner-K depth 8 fragments
hand-written ISA or very controlled CK path (compiler will not do this)
steps: Partition the inner K loop at the midpoint into two halves that each own 4 K fragments
Issue each half's weight loads as a separate HBM stream so two load fronts overlap the other half's MFMA
Tuck XQ/UQ scale loads at the end of the first half so they are ready when the second half needs them
Keep both halves writing into the SAME _v_Z / _v_GM1 accumulator -- the split is only a scheduling device
Tune s_waitcnt vmcnt(N) per half to bound outstanding loads without stalling the MFMA pipeline
expected_impact: improved HBM->MFMA overlap; reduces vmcnt stalls on weight-limited MoE tiles
